baselineRegression.reproduction: Temporarily retain a 414px sidebar in a 390px window, giving the canvas zero width before layout clamp.

rootCause: Document fitting divides transient DOM width by height instead of using the currently active camera projection. The resize listener skips zero dimensions and retains a valid projection, but a concurrent file load can attempt fitting before the layout settles.
fix: Fit against the active projection aspect. Existing resize framing scales the fitted view when dimensions become positive. No delayed document state or arbitrary fallback size is introduced.
